overview: The Zinc & Lead Processing MSME Support scheme is part of the Ministry of Mines' initiatives to promote critical mineral recycling and support MSMEs in the mining sector. It aims to provide financial and technical assistance to MSMEs engaged in zinc and lead processing activities, leveraging the Incentive Scheme for Promotion of Critical Minerals Recycling. The scheme falls under the broader Science and Technology Programme of the Ministry of Mines, specifically the S&T-PRISM component, which supports startups, MSMEs, and individual innovators in mining, mineral processing, metallurgy, and recycling sectors.
objectives: Promote research and innovation in startups and MSMEs in mining, mineral processing, metallurgy, and recycling sectors
Ensure timely availability of seed support to deserving startups and MSMEs
Support development of indigenous technologies for critical mineral processing
Encourage private sector participation in exploration and recycling of critical minerals
Facilitate circular economy practices in non-ferrous metal sector
Strengthen domestic capacity for critical mineral supply chain resilience
eligibility: Startups, MSMEs, and individual innovators engaged in activities related to mining, mineral processing, metallurgy, and recycling sectors are eligible for support under the S&T-PRISM programme. Entities must be registered in India and involved in innovative projects that align with the programme's focus areas.
benefits: Financial support in the form of grants for research and development projects, technical guidance, access to testing and analytical facilities, mentorship, and opportunities for collaboration with research institutions and industry partners. The scheme also facilitates access to government-backed infrastructure and data repositories for project implementation.
financial_support: Under the S&T-PRISM component of the Science and Technology Programme of the Ministry of Mines, funds are released to startups, MSMEs, and individual innovators to ensure timely availability of seed support for deserving projects. The financial support is provided as grants for research and development activities in the mining and mineral processing sectors.
application_process: 1. Identify the relevant scheme under S&T-PRISM programme 2. Prepare project proposal aligned with mining, mineral processing, metallurgy, or recycling focus areas 3. Submit application through the designated portal or channel 4. Application undergoes technical and financial evaluation 5. Approved projects receive grant sanction 6. Funds are disbursed in milestones based on project progress 7. Submit periodic progress reports and utilization certificates
required_documents: Project proposal detailing objectives, methodology, and expected outcomes
Certificate of incorporation or registration of the entity
PAN card of the entity or applicant
Details of any existing funding or partnerships
Undertaking regarding utilization of funds for the specified purpose
caveats: Funds are subject to availability and approval based on project evaluation
Grant utilization must be strictly for the approved project activities
Beneficiaries must submit periodic progress reports and utilization certificates
Intellectual property rights arising from the project may be subject to government norms
Projects must be completed within the stipulated timeline
